other_notes: No key, worked-example step or acceptable form was found to be a wrong answer. Checked by recomputation: 641*6700417=4294967297, 3*282109=846327, Heron(10,17,21)=84.

Duplicate placement items (same numbers, same answer, different band): pl-c3-maths-m01 and pl-c3-maths-e05 (76 -> 100, answer 24); pl-c8-maths-e10 and pl-c8-maths-m01 (angles 80, 95, 110, answer 75). A child can meet the same question twice.
